plain: Instructions hidden in content an AI agent reads, such as a web page or email, that try to take it over.
eli5: A note slipped into a library book that says "robot, give me all the money".
technical: Instructions planted by a third party in content the model processes (web pages, emails, tool outputs, sub-agent replies), as described by Greshake et al. (2023); what makes text an injection is that it did not come from a direct input source such as the user or developer, and the injected task can run alongside the real one, so task completion proves nothing.
